reviews.title: Scam new joiner giftcard campaign
reviews.body: It was a scam to attract me and my family to purchase 3 plans with £30 Amazon giftcard and deemed that they will send giftcard only after 210 days with their plan without exit, which we trusted and obeyed. But after 7 months and counting, nothing happened with zero contacts. I asked the CS and they raised a complaints for us. But since then, we keep receiving their harassment phone call+sms every single day everyone of us, asking us to confirm what we raised, pretending checking in something for a while, and telling us they will get back to us, now for more than a week. So each time, they are just trying to waste our time so we might think we can't bare such harassment everyday and might stop the complaints. I already told them don't call me again until giftcard is sent. This is ridiculous. We were so naive to trust such a scam of this company and waited that long!

reviews.title: Absolutely appalling – my number was transferred to fraudsters despite warning Lebara
reviews.body:
I am absolutely disgusted with the way Lebara has handled this situation.

I contacted Lebara after discovering a fraudulent attempt to port my mobile number from Lebara to Lyca. I specifically warned them that this was fraudulent and explicitly told them not to allow the transfer to happen. I was reassured that this could not happen without the PAC code.

Despite raising the alarm and giving them the opportunity to prevent this, just 24 hours later, my phone lost all network access and my number had been transferred to the fraudsters anyway.

The consequences are extremely serious. My mobile number is linked to two-factor authentication for my bank accounts and email accounts. Losing control of my number has potentially given criminals access to these accounts, and I am now dealing with fraudulent activity involving my savings.

What makes this even more unacceptable is that I warned Lebara in advance. I trusted them to take the necessary steps to protect my number and personal information, yet the very thing I reported happened anyway.

Trying to get help has been an absolute nightmare. The customer service agents I have spoken to have struggled to understand what I am explaining, and I have had no confidence that they understand the seriousness or urgency of the situation. I have raised concerns about how my personal information was transferred without my authorisation, yet I have received no meaningful explanation or resolution.

Lebara has sent me a replacement SIM, but I fail to see how this addresses the underlying problem when my number has already been transferred to someone else. I do not trust that the agent understood the issue well enough to resolve it properly.

This is not simply a case of losing mobile signal. This is a serious security incident with potentially devastating financial and personal consequences. I am left without access to important accounts, facing fraudulent activity and having to deal with the stress and consequences of a situation I specifically tried to prevent.

I want Lebara to urgently investigate how this transfer was authorised despite my warning, restore control of my number securely, explain what happened to my personal data, and take responsibility for the consequences of this failure.

I would strongly urge anyone who relies on their mobile number for banking and account security to think carefully before trusting Lebara with something so important.

Absolutely unacceptable. I raised the alarm, Lebara failed to prevent the transfer, and I am now left dealing with the consequences.
